brief:
Tala Darwish, a Palestinian content creator and photographer, has resumed work in Gaza by constructing a studio from aid pallets despite ongoing war and destruction, the Palestine News Network reported. Her makeshift facility enables her to continue documenting and sharing Palestinian narratives with international audiences amid the humanitarian crisis.

Darwish built the workspace from available materials in an environment marked by severe resource scarcity. She has returned to her work as a photographer and content creator despite conditions of active conflict and widespread destruction across Gaza.
dek: GAZA / PNN / War and destruction have not stopped Palestinian content creator and photographer Tala Darwish from returning to her work.
title: Gaza creator rebuilds studio from aid pallets to document Palestinian stories
